const carRaceCollision = (n) => {
  /**
   * Problem Analysis:
   * There are n cars moving left-to-right (L->R) and n cars moving right-to-left (R->L).
   * Since all cars move at the same speed and the road is a straight line, 
   * every single car moving L->R will eventually encounter and pass (collide with) 
   * every single car moving R->L.
   * 
   * Because the cars are "infinitely sturdy" and continue their trajectory, 
   * the total number of collisions is simply the number of pairs consisting 
   * of one L->R car and one R->L car.
   * 
   * Total collisions = (number of L->R cars) * (number of R->L cars)
   * Total collisions = n * n
   */
  return n * n;
};
```

```javascript
const carRaceCollision = (n) => {
  /**
   * Problem Analysis:
   * There are n cars moving left-to-right (L -> R) and n cars moving right-to-left (R -> L).
   * Since all cars move at the same speed and the road is a straight line, 
   * every car moving L -> R will eventually encounter every car moving R -> L 
   * because they start "very far from each other" and are moving towards each other.
   * 
   * Because the cars are "infinitely sturdy" and continue their trajectory as if 
   * they did not collide, each pair consisting of one L -> R car and one R -> L car 
   * will collide exactly once.
   * 
   * Total collisions = (number of L -> R cars) * (number of R -> L cars)
   * Total collisions = n * n
   */
  return n * n;
};
```
